items.title: 1.6.2 Applications of Design Patterns in Software Design (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of applications of design patterns (PDF 26).

blocks.text: Design patterns aam masail hal karne aur mazboot, sambhalne qabil code banane ke liye aam istemal hote hain. Yeh teen tarah madad karte hain, aur lachakdar, sambhalne qabil aur samajhne mein aasan nizam banane mein madad dete hain.

items: Wazeh banawat de kar code ki pecheedgi kam karna.
Aazmooda hal istemal kar ke code ka dobara istemal barhana.
Mushtarka alfaaz (vocabulary) de kar developers ka aapas mein rabta behtar karna.

blocks.prompt: Design patterns developers ka rabta kaise behtar karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh poore hal ke mushtarka naam dete hain: 'yahan Observer lagao' kehne se team ko poora design foran samajh aa jata hai.

items: Design patterns: pecheedgi kam, dobara istemal zyada, rabta behtar; lachakdar, sambhalne qabil, samajh aane wale nizam.
